answer: Challenge-response probes gate entry: a new identity answers a hardware nonce, so a forger needs its own silicon. One honest chip answers one prompt in constant time; a farm spinning N clones faces N probed roots needing a real PUF and sealed enclave, so cost rises linearly. A farm cannot buy in — provisioning is per-device, not a bulk subscription — and cannot parallelize: each probe runs live on real hardware. Detected clusters face slashing and a 30-epoch exclusion. Like a canyon holding back a flood, fake echoes collapse while a pearl of real identity stays clear.
